AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-26-2007 Text Ruling

AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-26-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Leticia Perez.
Petitioner: Adrian Pilar Marshall, present in pro per for self and as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Isaiah Lawrence Marshall, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Adrian Pilar Owens, and
grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Isaiah Lawrence Johnson.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-29-2006 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an ADULT and of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: F. Butler.
Petitioner: Adrian Pilar Marshall, present in pro per for self and as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Isaiah Lawrence Marshall, was sworn and examined.
Lacks the Minor's Father consent or proof of service on notice, the OSC for Change of Name of an Adult and of a Minor is continued to Feb. 22, 2007 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
Petitioner to file an Amended OSC and serve notice to the Minor's father of the new hearing date, and file proof of service with the court.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
The Court waived the re-publication requirement.
